public_source_observations.observation: Idempotency is about intended effect; automatic retry after communication failure requires idempotent semantics or equivalent safety knowledge.
A scheduled execution can under some circumstances create two Jobs or no Job; idempotent Jobs are recommended.
Even parallelism=1, completions=1, restartPolicy=Never does not prove a program starts only once.
At-least-once may replay; at-most-once per retry alone is not exactly-once across a workflow; non-idempotent effects require stronger discipline.
Update requires the current blob SHA and exposes conflict responses; repository content reads can be pinned by ref.
